Microsoft Defender for Cloud Pricings LIST 2024-01-01

steps: Confirm the exact subscription and the nonempty, current required Containers extension set with the owner; inspect pricing extension statuses and resource-level overrides.
If the observed plan or a required extension is disabled or absent, review billing, cluster applicability and deployment impact before changing the owned Defender configuration or IaC.
Verify provider operation status and actual cluster coverage separately after rollout; restore the previous approved configuration if coverage or cost is unacceptable.
azure.cis.auto_provision_defender_contai.summary: Align the Containers plan extensions with the subscription owner-approved required set.

Microsoft Defender for Cloud Pricings LIST 2024-01-01

steps: Inspect the exact subscription VirtualMachines pricing response, P2 subplan, FileIntegrityMonitoring extension and any operation status with the Defender and VM owners.

If the plan or extension is disabled, review cost, eligible machines, existing resource overrides and rollout impact; update the approved subscription Defender configuration or IaC only after owner approval.
Confirm activation and expected host telemetry on in-scope machines; if the change disrupts monitoring or billing expectations, restore the previous approved configuration.
azure.cis.file_integrity_monitoring_comp.summary: Review the P2 FileIntegrityMonitoring pricing declaration and verify host telemetry separately.
